card.statement: We have $\mathbf{Z}\Delta(G,T)\subset\mathbf{Z}\Delta^{\vee}(R,T^{\vee}_{\mathbf{k}})$ in $X^{*}(T)=X_{*}(T^{\vee}_{\mathbf{k}})$. Moreover, if this inclusion is an equality the root datum of $(R,T^{\vee}_{\mathbf{k}})$ is dual to that of $(G,T)$.
card.label: Lemma 14.10

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
